wiki.title: Braxton Mitchell
wiki.extract: Braxton Mitchell (born May 20, 2000) is an American politician and businessman who serves as the Republican Majority Whip of the Montana House of Representatives and as Chairman of the House Agriculture Committee. He represented Montana’s 3rd district from 2021 to 2025, and at the time, became one of the youngest elected officials in the country. Due to redistricting following the U.S. census, Mitchell ran for District 5 in the 2024 elections.
